theorem.name: FORCED_SEED_IDENTITY_ERASURE_FOR_FUTURE_STACK_V1
theorem.scope: After each B2B1 nonterminal canonical return, and only for the future B0/C0/C2/C3/B2A/R1/R2/B2B1 stack declared in the prereg, identities of newly forced seed vertices are not required as future semantic/proof state coordinates once their effects have been transferred to aggregate color masks and the forced-assignment reconstruction ledger is retained.

representation.frozen_root_provenance: Retain the original B0 provenance, including old source type T0(v)=N(v) intersect S0 for the frozen pre-B2B forcing seed S0 and all original selected-witness/support data.
representation.forced_assignment_ledger: Retain every newly forced/promoted fixed vertex identity and its fixed color for output reconstruction, audit and provenance tracing. This ledger is not used as a growing future-state branching coordinate.
representation.source_effect_mask: For each still-live vertex v retain chi_S(v), the 4-bit set of colors occurring on current seed neighbors.
representation.X0_effect_mask: For each still-live vertex v retain chi_X0(v), the 4-bit set of colors occurring on current X0 neighbors.
representation.live_graph: Retain the graph on still-live nonfixed vertices and the current residual component partition/incidences.
representation.certificates: Retain inherited seed-connectedness/no-complete-to-seed certificates and independent reconstruction pointers for deleted/compiled components.

reason: B0 O1 proves every later competing survivor is inherited from the original source L2 survivor set; B2B1 strengthens this to survivor-set shrinkage under forcing.
B0 coarse signature explicitly uses old source type T(v) for the frozen source seed. This original provenance is retained unchanged.
New forced seed identities are not needed to create a new source type coordinate: current source-list changes are captured by chi_S, while current component uniformity is rederived from axiom (iv).

C0.reason: Residual Y0 is anticomplete to the seed. C0 internal base lists depend on fixed X0 colors and boundary semantics depend on D_C color masks; no seed-neighbor identity is read.

C2.reason: Q_ALL uses G[U], residual component nodes and complete/anticomplete dynamic-component incidence. It contains no seed identity coordinate.

C3.reason: C3 explicitly uses exact A(u)=[4] minus colors on fixed S union X0 neighbors, not seed identities, plus C0/C2 data and reconstruction pointers.

B2A.reason: B2A signatures use proper-mask rho bits, component message IDs, A(b), D_C and finite delta bitsets. No new-seed identity coordinate occurs.

reason: Once the fixed assignment is certified proper, a fixed vertex constrains a still-live neighbor only by forbidding its fixed color.
For each live vertex, the conjunction of all fixed-neighbor constraints is exactly the forbidden-color set chi_S union chi_X0.
R1 and R2 additionally use the live dynamic graph for properness among still-unfixed vertices. They do not require which fixed identity supplied an already-forbidden color.
Source-list repartition Z0..Z4 depends only on chi_S.
Z1 unique colors depend only on chi_S; exact fixed conflicts use the live graph at the moment of promotion plus fixed-color masks.
Axiom (vi) preservation uses source-list/color classes and retained component adjacency, not new seed identities.
Seed connectedness is maintained by an inherited certificate plus the fact that every newly forced u has chi_S(u) nonempty at forcing time; the identity of its seed neighbor is irrelevant.
No-outside-complete-to-seed is monotone under seed enlargement and therefore needs only the inherited certificate.

For connectivity repair, every live non-Y0 vertex with chi_S nonempty belongs to the seed-connected side because the seed is certified connected. Residual Y0 connectivity to that side is determined by the live dynamic/component incidence. New seed identities need not remain explicit graph vertices in the future key.

B1_B2_firewall.B1_full_grammar: EXCLUDED_FROM_THEOREM_SCOPE. B1's historical covering grammar explicitly stores tau=N(v) intersect S as an identity bitset. This result does not retroactively rewrite or invalidate B1.
B1_B2_firewall.B2_dynamic_core_rules: The already sealed B-X0 and B-B rules used on the dynamic-core frontier are mask/palette based, but rerunning the full B1 grammar with S-role reasoning requires a separate adapter if ever needed.
B1_B2_firewall.consequence: Future B2B2 state compression may omit newly forced seed identity neighborhoods only because the declared future stack does not require rerunning identity-sensitive B1 source-role grammar.

reconstruction_firewall.meaning: Erasure is from the future semantic/proof key, not from the final coloring/output record.

coordinates: frozen original B0 provenance T0/J/Q where applicable
reconstruction ledger/pointers outside the semantic key
canonical_future_key_after_B.removed_coordinate: growing exact neighborhood bitset of each live vertex into newly forced seed identities

effect_on_multiplicity.per_vertex_effect_alphabet: constant 4-bit chi_S plus 4-bit chi_X0, before other live-graph/component coordinates

explicit_nonclaims: No theorem that arbitrary future source arguments are identity-free.
No theorem that the full B1 grammar can be rerun without tau identities.
No polynomial bound on global per-vertex mask assignments.
